name: Get lists
description: Call this when you need to retrieve a paginated collection of contact lists, optionally filtered by folder and sorted. Use the list‑details endpoint (if available) when you need information about a single list or its members.

folder_id.description: Identifier of the folder to filter lists; empty string returns lists from all folders.

limit.description: Maximum number of lists to return per page. Defaults to 20 if omitted.

offset.description: Page offset (starting at 1). Used together with limit for pagination.

sort_key.description: Field to sort the results by. "entered" sorts by creation date.

sort_order.description: Direction of sorting; "asc" for ascending, "desc" for descending.

count.description: Number of contacts in the list.

entered.description: Timestamp when the list was created, in "DD-MM-YYYY HH:MM:SS" format.

isDynamicList.description: Flag indicating if the list is dynamic (1) or static (0).

data.description: Array of list objects matching the query.

total_count.description: Total number of lists available across all pages.
